title: Certify QQ16's separate entry-frame adapter tariff
body:
## Summary

PR #2540 recovers all 224 original logical arrays in `F_U1` but leaves their consumer frames open. This proves and constructs the sharp native tariff for separate per-field adapters to the original physical entry gauges:

```text
224 recovered arrays in F_U1
  -> 112 rank-16 + 112 rank-17 native children
  -> original x in C_q, original y in I
```

The adapter rank mass is **3,696**. Appending the unchanged added decoder gives `224 H1 + 16 H8 + 112 H16 + 112 H17`, mass **4,048**. The less demanding F0 gauges cost 1,904; common `F_L` costs 1,792. These change the frames of original x,y, not their logical contents.

The lower bound uses binary phase polarization and includes arbitrary products of single-field convolution kernels and affine payload permutations/translations, at every positive common tensor depth. Explicit orthogonal charts and translations attain it and minimize the separate native moment for `0 <= a < 1`.

Cross-field synthesis, shared children, borrowed observations, payload phase masks and fusion with the decoder or a later consumer are outside the theorem. A caller that directly accepts `F_U1` can avoid these adapters. Physical wrappers, movement, hosting, precision, F0/B1 costs and global supplier admission remain open; no new κ or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- Before: PR #2540's exact retained proof specifies common `F_U1` outputs and leaves the original physical-frame/consumer obligation unresolved.
- After: all 112 actual port labels, 448 adapters, 68,992 adapter phase checks, 17,248 source-hole phase checks and six rejecting semantic controls pass. A separate Gaussian-integer convolution check covers all 131,072 addresses for the first actual entry-X adapter.
- The registered Python 3.12.15 replay passes normally and with `-O`, plus six artifact tests for source/result corruption, read-only Git-free relocation, overwrite refusal, compilation and physical convolution. A separate internal mathematical review and artifact review found no material issue; no independent human review or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-entry-frame-tariff
```

The package contains the scoped proof, literal adapters, exact source pins and open next questions. No predecessor executable or full selected cold replay is run. Base `b4560d9e`, priority revision 5; canonical-main compatibility and live-overlap details are recorded in `TASK.json`. [Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2657).

Credit ywz65/#2540 and #2511/#2512; commdata2338/#2651 for parallel bank reuse with the same endpoint; Ali Romman and the retained QQ16 geometry/native/owner lineage, including starship-s, Sagar Thakrar and Ross Richardson. Source bytes and notices are retained. Apache-2.0. Substantial AI assistance was used.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Adds only `research/qq16-entry-frame-tariff/` and its opt-in replay manifest. Existing selected and frozen evidence remain unchanged.
